messages:
Alice (FinOps): Quick follow-up from the token-variance postmortem. We need clear owners + deadlines for invoice corrections, delayed-ingest fix, recurrence detection, and customer comms. Observed ~+12% token delta for 4 accounts due to delayed batch replays.
Ben (Eng): I can own the ingest-side fix + verification. Plan: patch + smoke on staging today, prod backfill tomorrow.
Carol (Metering): Ill own recurrence detection and alerts. Propose: P1 (>=10% deviation in 1h) -> page; P2 (>=5% in 24h) -> slack.
Dilip (SRE): Ill handle ledger reconcile & invoice reissue integration with finance. Need playbook updates (commands + rollback).
Alice (FinOps): Deadlines? Ben: ingest patch by EOD today. Carol: detection rules by Fri AM. Dilip: reissue playbook + dry-run next Tue.
Ben (Eng): EOD patch ok. Quick delta query Ill run to validate: 
```
SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, SUM(tokens) tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, hr
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Ben (Eng): Posting smoke results shortly.
Carol (Metering): Short-term alert guard to avoid flapping: require 2 consecutive buckets OR >5000 token delta. Ill add notebook with examples and dashboards.
Dilip (SRE): Alice, drop the impacted customer list into FIN-448 so I can script pro-rated credits.
Alice (FinOps): Done  CSV attached to FIN-448 and customers tagged for outreach.
metering-bot: Invoice Reissue Job queued job_id=jr-20240429-57 status=queued (FIN-448).
Ben (Eng): Staging smoke passed; root cause looks like two shard windows reprocessed. Logs: ingest_worker_42: processed 45k events, 0 errors.
Carol (Metering): Detection rule PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/412. Requesting review from @Ben and @Dilip.
Dilip (SRE): Reconcile script draft at //ops/reconcile/reissue_dryrun.sh. Dry-run scheduled Mon 10:00 UTC.
Alice (FinOps): Recap of owners & dates: Ben - patch + staging smoke (today), prod backfill (tomorrow). Carol - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Dilip - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 10:00 UTC), playbook update + prod window Wed if dry-run good. Finance will draft comms after dry-run.
Ben (Eng): Will also add a late-batch latency metric to reduce repeat.
Carol (Metering): Will create Grafana panels and the alert.
Dilip (SRE): If dry-run OK Ill request production window & coordinate on rollback steps.
Alice (FinOps): Please post quick status updates here as each milestone completes. Ill mark FIN-448 as "postmortem actions" when closed. :thumbsup:
